markets.early_close_condition: This market will close and expire early if the economic data is released.
markets.rules_primary:
If U.S. commercial crude oil inventories for the week ending Oct 23, 2026 are strictly above 

418 million barrels, then the market resolves to Yes.
markets.rules_secondary:
The Underlying is the U.S. Commercial Crude Oil (Excl. Lease Stock) inventory level reported by the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) for the week ending Oct 23, 2026. This measure excludes crude oil held in the Strategic Petroleum Reserve (SPR).

EIA reports the statistic in thousand barrels. Values stated in millions of barrels will be converted directly from the EIA-reported value. The market will use the first EIA publication for the specified week. Subsequent revisions will not affect resolution.
